metadata.database: A Deeper China | Guilin–Yangshuo decision layer

GYM01.guest_need: A visitor wants a karst relationship, not a scenic checklist.
GYM01.hidden_need: Choose whether the core is water, land views, photography or rest before booking movement.
GYM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One landscape question is more useful than stacking every famous viewpoint.
GYM01.stop_condition: The visitor can describe one karst/water/settlement relationship.
GYM01.low_energy_branch: Use one accessible viewpoint and a long seated landscape pause.
GYM01.rain_branch: Keep fog/rain-compatible viewpoints only after conditions are checked.
GYM01.body_cost: Variable walking and exposure; heat, humidity and terrain matter.

GYM02.guest_need: A visitor needs to choose cruise, shorter water section or land-based river views.
GYM02.hidden_need: Make water length, motion, luggage and weather cost explicit.
GYM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One water movement choice defines the day; combining cruise and multiple river edges creates fatigue.
GYM02.stop_condition: The chosen river relationship and return plan are clear.
GYM02.low_energy_branch: Choose the shortest verified water or land-view option.
GYM02.rain_branch: Release only after water, wind, visibility and operator checks.

GYM03.guest_need: A visitor wants Yangshuo countryside without assuming cycling, rafting or athletic ability.
GYM03.hidden_need: Match movement mode to body, road and water conditions.
GYM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One slow countryside movement pattern gives depth without a forced activity.
GYM03.stop_condition: The visitor has experienced one countryside relationship safely.
GYM03.low_energy_branch: Use a non-cycling public walk/vehicle-assisted branch.
GYM03.rain_branch: Remove water/cycling unless same-day safety and operator checks pass.
GYM03.body_cost: Low-to-high depending on bike, raft and terrain; never infer from map distance.

GYM04.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide where nights and energy belong: town or quieter countryside.
GYM04.hidden_need: Prevent accommodation geography from making every day a transfer.
GYM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A stay-location decision can improve the whole trip more than another attraction.
GYM04.stop_condition: The visitor has a base that matches desired night rhythm and transport tolerance.
GYM04.low_energy_branch: Choose one base and avoid nightly relocation.
GYM04.rain_branch: Choose the base with the strongest indoor/recovery options.

GYM05.guest_need: A visitor wants walking, photography or adventure with honest exposure limits.
GYM05.hidden_need: Separate landscape desire from fear, footing and rescue/return risk.
GYM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One bounded physical experiment is safer and more meaningful than several viewpoints.
GYM05.stop_condition: The chosen route question is answered before surface or weather risk rises.
GYM05.low_energy_branch: Use a low-commitment viewpoint and no exposed activity.
GYM05.rain_branch: Remove hikes/rafts until footing and visibility are current-checked.
GYM05.body_cost: Potentially high steps, exposure, heat and footing risk.

GYM06.guest_need: A visitor needs Guilin to work as a city chapter or a recovery/transfer node.
GYM06.hidden_need: Protect arrival and luggage days from forced scenery.
GYM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A humane arrival/recovery block is more valuable than adding a distant landscape stop.
GYM06.stop_condition: The visitor is rested, oriented and ready for the next transfer.
GYM06.low_energy_branch: Keep one city/river-edge layer near the hotel.
GYM06.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high transfer and weather sensitivity.

GYM07.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide if Longji deserves a separate mountain day.
GYM07.hidden_need: Prevent rice terraces from being squeezed into a Yangshuo itinerary.
GYM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: It is a separate landscape and transfer question, not a bonus viewpoint.
GYM07.stop_condition: The visitor accepts the extra day, weather and mountain transfer cost.
GYM07.low_energy_branch: Do not add it; keep Guilin–Yangshuo coherent.
GYM07.rain_branch: Decide only after current mountain visibility and transport checks.
GYM07.body_cost: High transfer, terrain and weather cost.

GYM08.guest_need: A visitor needs the itinerary to survive rain, fog, water changes and transfers.
GYM08.hidden_need: Keep a protected buffer rather than pretending scenery is guaranteed.
GYM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A weather/transfer buffer protects the trip’s central question better than another fixed attraction.
GYM08.stop_condition: The route has a credible fallback and no unsafe handoff.
GYM08.low_energy_branch: Keep one local layer and a protected recovery block.
GYM08.rain_branch: This is the primary weather branch; remove unsafe water/terrain activity.
GYM08.body_cost: Operational rather than scenic cost: delays, luggage and uncertainty.
